task.title: Build learning from failures: 1) Track all failed/stuck tasks with error types, 2) Pattern detection (tasks of type X fail when...), 3) Root cause analysis, 4) Suggest fixes based on history, 5) Learn retry strategies, 6) Early detection of mission-impossible tasks. PostgreSQL enables deep analysis that OpenClaw's files cannot.
